item.title: PSG score late to sink Barcelona 4-2 in Champions League blockbuster
item.description: Late strikes by Vitinha and Fabian Ruiz grab victory for PSG as they aim to win the UCL for third season running.

item.description: Mortazavi: The war on Iran could strengthen Iranian nationalism rather than trigger regime change.

item.description: Duo was first arrested for suspected link to incident at US-run airbase used for striking Iran during this year's war.

item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu says he discussed the need to topple Iran’s regime with US President Trump.

item.title: UK to deploy fighter jets to defend Saudi Arabia
item.description: British Typhoon jets will carry out defensive missions to protect Saudi Arabia from escalating Houthi attacks.

item.title: Swimmer, 65, killed in shark attack off South Africa's east coast
item.description: Janine Lochrenberg, 65, was out on her daily morning swim with her club when she was attacked, her family tell the BBC.

item.title: Houthi missile strike on Yemen camp kills 73 security recruits, local authorities say
item.description: Three missiles hit a camp in government-controlled Shabwa province on Monday that was being used as a training centre, Yemen's army says.

item.title: Deadly fire at Canada military base moved a kilometre 'in 30 to 60 seconds'
item.description: The blaze that killed four men and injured dozens of others spread with alarming speed, accounts suggest.

item.title: Why Israeli Gen Z voters are drawn to the far right
item.description: More than half a million young people will cast their ballots in Israel next week - and they could make all the difference.
